title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one flower opens by day and closes at night
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Seek a dated botanical primary that identifies one species and explicitly describes the same flower opening and closing at opposite times of day, without importing a modern circadian explanation. A target needs an admitted depiction or author-owned text that separates the two flower states and times; generic petals and sequential paragraphs give no such owner. This probes a state-change word, not a plant name inferred from appearance.

design.mechanism: reversible daily state change of one flower
design.unit: paired complete state-and-time references for one independently identified flower
design.contrast: open versus closed state word against day/night marker or repeated flower name
design.prediction: fixed candidates switch with source-owned flower state while an independently bound species expression remains stable
